closure_producer_invocations.definition: post-ACCEPT closure invocations, one blocked and one resumed

implementation_elapsed_seconds.definition: sum of recorded initial and repair PRODUCER invocation durations; excludes verification and queue time

repair_elapsed_seconds.definition: first REJECT Issue-comment timestamp to repair-candidate Issue-comment timestamp

closure_elapsed_seconds.definition: independent ACCEPT Issue-comment timestamp to DONE Issue-comment timestamp; includes authority wait

candidate_custody_failures.scope: the two published candidates reviewed for PY-02; verifier reported each candidate identifiable and retrievable

architecture_violations.scope: accepted candidate and merge-result evidence; this is not a claim about future revisions

token_usage.note: all six invocation logs expose token fields, but producer and verifier schemas differ and are not summed

cost.unknown: producer costs and therefore end-to-end cost

unknown_metrics: human-attention quality beyond elapsed blocked time
